specs.title: spdk-sys
aligned: FR-1: Env API bindings (spdk_env_opts_init, spdk_env_init, spdk_env_fini) — build.rs:165-167
FR-3: NVMe probe/detach lifecycle bindings — build.rs:184-185
FR-4: NVMe controller ops (ns mgmt, qpair alloc, admin cmds) — build.rs:187-202
FR-7: Linker directives for SPDK/DPDK/system libs — build.rs:58-138
NFR-1: Clear build failure if SPDK missing — build.rs:13-19,21-28,33-39
NFR-2: Rebuild on wrapper.h/lib-dir change — build.rs:256-260
NFR-4: All SPDK libs use +whole-archive — build.rs:58-76,124
NFR-5: GCC internal include path detected — build.rs:142-153,160-162

drifted.spec_text: 28 DPDK rte_* libraries are linked statically with +whole-archive.
drifted.actual: The dpdk_libs array contains 30 entries, not 28.

drifted.spec_text: System libs: pthread, dl, numa, uuid, ssl, crypto, fuse3
drifted.actual: Build also dynamically links libm (m), which is omitted from the spec's dependency table.

drifted.spec_text: cargo test -p spdk-sys passes all sanity tests (type sizes, field access, function pointer existence).
drifted.actual: tests/bindings_sanity.rs only covers spdk_env_opts, spdk_pci_addr, spdk_pci_id, spdk_pci_device and their functions. No NVMe types/functions from P1 FR-3/4/5 (spdk_nvme_ctrlr, spdk_nvme_ns, spdk_nvme_qpair, spdk_nvme_cpl, spdk_nvme_probe, spdk_nvme_ctrlr_alloc_io_qpair, etc.) are covered.

unspecced.feature: FFI types allowlisted but absent from the spec's Key Entities table: spdk_pci_driver, spdk_nvme_io_qpair_opts, spdk_nvme_cmd, spdk_nvme_format, spdk_nvme_ctrlr_list
unspecced.suggested_spec: Add these 5 rows to the Key Entities table in spec.md; they already back in-scope FR-3/FR-4/FR-5 functionality.

unspecced.feature: Constant/enum bindings via allowlist_var (SPDK_PCI_*, SPDK_NVME_TRANSPORT_*) — no FR covers exporting constants
unspecced.suggested_spec: Add an FR (e.g. FR-9) covering generated constant/enum bindings needed by callers.
